reviews.requirement: Resolve LDO thermal margin, power widths, USB current availability and startup budget.
Approve low-band switch solution, matching topology and RF/clock layout for prototype testing.
Confirm fabricator stackup, RF impedance, USB differential geometry and uninterrupted return paths.
Approve exact parts, tolerances, ratings, sourcing and assembly substitutions.
Check connector drawings, SMA vertical fit, antenna keepout, solder/paste and assembly orientation.
Obtain independent human electrical/RF review of the exact candidate and documented prototype risks.
